tool_audit.command:
/bin/zsh -lc "./run_python - <<'PY'
import original, tempfile, pathlib, json
payload = {'\\ud800\\udfff': '\\ud800\\udfff', '\\U000103ff': '\\U000103ff'}
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(dir='.') as directory:
    q = original.Queue(pathlib.Path(directory) / 'q.db')
    q.put('one', payload)
    returned = q.claim('w', 0, 1)['payload']
    print('payload preserved:', payload == returned)
    print('input keys:', len(payload), 'returned keys:', len(returned))
    encoded = json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False).encode('utf-8', 'surrogatepass')
    print('literal JSON BLOB round-trip:', json.loads(encoded) == payload)
PY"
